title: Ouch!
text: Ouch!. I got one of these for me, the other for my husband. They were completely different in size and density. (His was overstuffed, mine was was about 3/4 of the way full.) We each used them, me for three nights, him for 2 nights. Our necks and backs were in so much more pain than they were before we started using them. I'm retuning both of them today.
